readback.name: Poincare.RefinedFiniteAtlasExistence.exists_refined_atlasData
readback.mathematical_statement: For every universe-u compact Hausdorff type M charted over E = EuclideanSpace real (Fin 3) and smooth for the self model with corners, and every family p -> V(p) of open coordinate subsets with c_p(p) in V(p), there exists an AtlasData A on M. Its cover contains finitely many anchors indexed by Fin A.cover.chartCount, and the genuine extended-chart sources at those anchors cover M. Its regions U_i are open, their union is all of M, closure U_i is contained in the source of the chart c_i at the corresponding anchor, and c_i '' closure U_i is compact. A also contains a smooth nonnegative partition of unity on M whose topological supports are contained in the corresponding U_i. In addition to those AtlasData fields, each anchor belongs to its own region and c_i '' closure U_i is contained in V evaluated at that anchor. The family V is chosen before A, and no preexisting finite atlas or partition is supplied. The assertion does not impose connectedness, a metric, favorable curvature, or an operator estimate. The coordinate support defined by this A is c_i '' tsupport(A.partition i), so it has the compactness and genuine-target containment supplied by the stated AtlasData fields.
